card.name: Final piece of drug names in interactions
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug name that is split into parts, such as digoxin, naproxen, propafenone, ganciclovir or MPA. It appears in drug interaction passages where the drug is named as the interacting agent.

modes.label: Ending of digoxin
modes.description: The closing 'in' of digoxin when it is named as an interacting drug.

modes.label: Ending of other drug names
modes.description: The last piece of naproxen, propafenone, ganciclovir or the abbreviation MPA.
